esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; U2.SLP → D25 (GPIO25). U2.AIN2 → D26 (GPIO26). U2.AIN1 → D27 (GPIO27). Added a separate 9 V supply for VM (it needs 2.7–10.8 V and up to 2 A, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the drv8833.py driver written from the datasheet.
Wakes the driver, runs motor A forward, then lets it coast: passes
